description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) of knowledge probing on BioGPT and Llama2 after editing with different methods, with "Base" representing the LLM without editing. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and ranges from 60% to 80%. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different editing method: Base (black line with circle markers), MEND (brown line with diamond markers), FT (blue line with triangle markers), MEMIT (purple line with pentagon markers), IKE (red line with inverted triangle markers), and ROME (green line with square markers). The Base line starts at approximately 65% accuracy at the lowest co-occurrence number and ends at around 70% at the highest co-occurrence number. The MEND line starts at about 70% and ends near 80%. The FT line begins at roughly 65% and concludes at about 75%. The MEMIT line starts at approximately 70% and finishes at around 78%. The IKE line begins at about 68% and ends near 77%. The ROME line starts at around 72% and concludes at approximately 80%. All lines show a general upward trend, indicating an increase in accuracy with higher co-occurrence numbers.
